content.short: Okto is a self-custody wallet and embedded wallet SDK from CoinDCX.
content.description: Okto is a self-custody trading wallet built around Hyperliquid, offering DEX futures at up to 50x leverage on 100-plus pairs including pre-launch tokens. Cross-chain swaps complete in one click across EVM, Solana and Aptos, with an in-line bridge and no need to hold a native token for gas. Hyperliquid spot markets are live in the same app alongside native charts and signals. Running both the wallet and the trading product means the underlying SDK is tested against a real consumer app.
